requirements.quote: In authorization responses to the client, including error responses, an authorization server supporting this specification MUST indicate its identity by including the iss parameter in the response.

The iss parameter value is the issuer identifier of the authorization server which created the authorization response, as defined in [RFC8414]. Its value MUST be a URL that uses the "https" scheme without any query or fragment components.
requirements.$comment: Merged into §2: RFC 9207 §2 is "Response Parameter iss" and carries both the emit and the value requirements. An earlier draft of this row declared §2.1, which no test cites and which the gate correctly refused.

requirements.quote: Authorization servers SHOULD publish the value true for the metadata parameter authorization_response_iss_parameter_supported.
Clients that support this specification MUST extract the value of the iss parameter from authorization responses and MUST validate it.
requirements.reason: Binds the client, not the authorization server. QAuth is the AS; @qauth-labs/mcp-guard is a resource-server helper, not an OAuth client.
